observations: Rectangular center table with a white marble-patterned top.
Two-tier design with a matching lower shelf.
The legs have a curved 'C' shape at the top and straight feet.
The surface shows grey veining characteristic of marble or marble-effect laminate.
Photos 0 and 1 are nearly identical, taken from a high angle.

claims.evidence: The photos show a marble pattern, but it is impossible to distinguish between a ceramic tile, real marble, or a laminate/sticker on MDF from this distance.

risks.risk: The top may be MDF or particle board with a marble-effect sticker rather than ceramic.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge of the tabletop to see the cross-section.

risks.risk: The gold finish on the legs may be chipped, rusted, or poorly painted.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the leg joints and feet.

risks.risk: The table may be unstable or wobbly due to the thin leg design.
risks.proof: A video of the table being shaken or having weight applied.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the tabletop edge to confirm material.
Video showing the table's stability when pushed.
Clear photos of the underside where the legs attach to the frame.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a two-tier center table. Although the material claim of 'ceramic' is unverified, the item can be priced at the worst-case value of a standard laminate/MDF marble-effect table.
